rows.ARS:
Medium red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Velindre
rows.Origin:
Bred by Lionel Poole (United Kingdom, 1998).
Introduced in United Kingdom by C & K Jones in 2007 as 'Velindre'.
rows.Bloom: Red, peach reverse. Moderate fragrance. Average diameter 5.5". Very large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, few or no prickles/thorns, upright. Large, semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 3' (90cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
